newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U seeks Europe approval for new anti-depressant.
newsitem.headline: P&U seeks Europe approval for new anti-depressant.

text.p: U.S./Swedish drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn on Thursday said it was seeking permission to market a new anti-depressant drug, reboxetin, in Europe.
P&U said it had applied to Britain's Medicines Control Agency (MCA) for approval to market reboxetine.
The MCA will review the application on behalf of the European Union and make a recommendation for other EU members.

The company said in a statement that reboxetine is in a class of drugs called noradrenaline reuptake inhibitors which are believed to increase the availability of noradrenaline in the brain. Insufficient noradrenaline is linked to depression.
P&U said the use of the drug had been studied in more than 1,500 adults and elderly patients suffering from major depression.
"In addition to the UK, Pharmacia & Upjohn is submitting registration applications for reboxetine in a number of other markets," the company said.
